paras: The streak-crowned mountain tanager (Dubusia stictocephala) is a species of Neotropical bird in the tanager family Thraupidae. The streak-crowned mountain tanager is found only in north to south-central Peru. The streak-crowned mountain tanager is sometimes regarded as a subspecies of the buff-breasted mountain tanager but has been distinguished otherwise in 2023 by the International Ornithologists' Union.
